summary.en: ASP.NET Core VOD catalogue with HLS processing, R2 storage and administration.
summary.pl: Katalog VOD ASP.NET Core z HLS, magazynem R2 i panelem administracyjnym.

estimation.sourceState: local worktree with 70 changed paths and unpublished commits

current.en: Reconcile 12 local commits and the large uncommitted feature set without data loss.
current.pl: Uporządkować 12 lokalnych commitów i duży niezacommitowany zakres bez utraty pracy.

next.en: Fix the vulnerable dependency and production hardening before release.
next.pl: Naprawić podatną zależność i zabezpieczenia przed wydaniem.

title.en: Finish i18n, storage and video processing refactor
title.pl: Dokończyć i18n, storage i przetwarzanie wideo

tasks.evidence: Seventy changed paths include storage, FFmpeg, jobs and UI work that is not represented by public CI.

title.en: Remove warnings, skipped tests and vulnerabilities
title.pl: Usunąć warningi, skipped testy i podatności

tasks.evidence: The public workflow is green, but local changes and deferred security work remain.

title.en: Require green CI on protected main
title.pl: Wymagać zielonego CI na chronionym main

tasks.evidence: GitHub returned no active ruleset or environment.
Documentation does not yet describe the complete dirty implementation or v2 delivery model.

title.en: Add login, upload and transcoding limits
title.pl: Dodać limity logowania, uploadu i transkodowania

tasks.evidence: No application rate-limit implementation was found; HLS requires bandwidth rather than low request limits.

title.en: Move build to GHCR and deploy by digest
title.pl: Przenieść build do GHCR i wdrażać digest

tasks.evidence: The VPS currently rebuilds a local image and globally prunes Docker images.

title.en: Add readiness, stable gateway and blue-green
title.pl: Dodać readiness, stabilny gateway i blue-green

tasks.evidence: Health checks exist, but there is no candidate promotion, drain or public rollback smoke test.
Central monitoring and actionable deployment/transcoding alerts were not verified.
